seo.title: Apple Business Connect Is Now Apple Business
seo.meta_description: Apple Business Connect is now Apple Business. What changed, how to sign in and what Orange County businesses should do about their Apple Maps listings.

h1: Apple Business Connect Is Now Apple Business: What Local Businesses Should Do
answer: Apple Business Connect is now Apple Business, according to Apple's own guide. Apple Business combines Apple Business Manager, Apple Business Essentials and Apple Business Connect in one place, including the tools for managing how your business appears on Apple Maps. Existing users can sign in with the same Apple Account. Anaheim and Orange County businesses should check their listings and verification.
key_takeaways: Apple Business Connect is now Apple Business.
It combines three former Apple business products.
You can sign in with your existing Apple Account.
Ads on Maps are available in the U.S. and Canada.

sections.heading: What changed
sections.body_html: Apple's Apple Business Connect guide now states that Apple Business Connect is now Apple Business. Apple says Apple Business combines the capabilities of Apple Business Manager, Apple Business Essentials and Apple Business Connect into a single offering, covering both internal operations and customer-facing tools such as your Apple Maps listing.

sections.heading: Signing in
sections.body_html: Apple says you can sign in to Apple Business at business.apple.com with the personal Apple Account you used for Apple Business Connect. You can create an Apple Account for Work, a Managed Apple Account with the full feature set, or keep your personal account and use only brand and location management.

sections.heading: Organizations become units
sections.body_html: If you managed more than one organization in Apple Business Connect, Apple says they now appear as organizational units, and you can switch between them after agreeing to the terms.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.body_html: Apple's guide says organizations have 60 days to verify, using two methods, such as a D-U-N-S Number or EIN plus an official business document, and that verification can take up to five business days.

sections.heading: What you can still do for Apple Maps
sections.body_html:
• Add and verify locations and fix pins.
  • Complete the place card with logo, cover photo and about section.
  • Upload photos and create showcases.
  • Add Actions such as Order or Reserve.
  • Read insights on searches, views and actions.

sections.heading: Ads on Apple Maps
sections.body_html: Apple Business also includes ads on Maps. Apple says they're available in the United States and Canada for advertisers with locations and an organization address there, with a monthly budget you control.

sections.heading: Why this matters for local businesses
sections.body_html: The place card appears across Apple's apps, from Maps to Siri, Calendar and Messages, according to Apple's guide. Many iPhone users in Anaheim and across Orange County never open another map app, so an accurate Apple listing matters as much as your Google Business Profile.

sections.heading: What to do this week
sections.body_html:
1. Sign in at business.apple.com with your existing Apple Account.
  2. Accept the new terms and choose how you want to sign in.
  3. Check your organization's verification status.
  4. Review each location's name, pin, hours and phone.
  5. Make sure Apple's emails reach your inbox.

sections.heading: Keep listings consistent
sections.body_html: Apple Maps and Google Maps are separate. Whatever you change on one, change on the other, and on your website and main directories. Consistent details help customers and the apps and AI assistants that read business data.

sections.heading: A worked example
sections.body_html: Imagine a flower shop in Fullerton that set up Apple Business Connect two years ago. The owner signs in to Apple Business with the same Apple Account, keeps the personal account for brand and location management, confirms the shop is verified, updates holiday hours and adds a Valentine's Day showcase. Nothing about the listing was lost in the change.

sections.heading: Our Apple Business guides
sections.body_html: We've published step-by-step guides to setting up Apple Business, adding locations, completing the place card, photos, showcases, Actions, insights, Branded Mail, Tap to Pay on iPhone and ads on Apple Maps, each checked against Apple's own guide.

sections.heading: Questions owners ask us
sections.body_html: Owners often ask whether they need to set up their Apple Maps listing again. Apple's guide says existing Apple Business Connect users can sign in with the same personal Apple Account, so the starting point is to sign in and review what's there. Another common question is whether Apple Business costs money. Apple's pages describe ads on Maps as a paid option with its own budget; check Apple's current terms for anything else. Owners also ask whether a personal Apple Account is enough. For brand and location management, Apple says yes; a Managed Apple Account unlocks the full feature set, which matters more for businesses that also manage Apple devices.

sections.heading: A checklist for multi-location businesses
sections.body_html: If you have several locations in Orange County, sign in and confirm every location appears under the right brand and organizational unit. Check each pin, hours and phone number, and make sure each location has its own cover photo where the locations look different. Assign access to the right people, and confirm Apple's change emails reach someone who will act on them. Then plan monthly showcases and review insights by location to see which ones need attention.

sections.heading: Why Apple Maps deserves attention
sections.body_html: It's easy to focus only on Google, but many customers never leave Apple's apps. When someone taps an address in a text message, accepts a calendar invite with a location or asks Siri for the nearest pharmacy, Apple's place card is what they see. For businesses near Anaheim's resort area, visitors from out of town often rely on whatever map their phone opens by default. An accurate Apple listing with photos, hours and Actions makes sure those customers find the right door at the right time, without extra advertising spend.

sections.heading: What to watch for next
sections.body_html: Apple's guide now lives under the Apple Business name, and Apple publishes the date each page was updated. Check the guide when you notice a new option in your account, because features such as showcases, Actions and insights may gain new capabilities. Keep a short record of what you change in Apple Business each month, alongside your Google Business Profile changes, so you can match changes to results in Apple's insights.

sections.heading: How Apple and Google listings work together
sections.body_html: Think of Apple Business and Google Business Profile as two front doors to the same business. Each has its own tools, review processes and insights, but customers expect the same name, address, phone number, hours and website on both. Make changes in both on the same day, such as holiday hours, a new phone number or a move, and keep your website as the source both can match. Review both sets of insights each month side by side. For most Orange County businesses, Google will bring more traffic, but Apple Maps users are often ready to visit, call or book, so the effort pays off.

sections.heading: The short version
sections.body_html: Apple Business Connect is now Apple Business. Sign in with your existing Apple Account, check verification and keep your Apple Maps listing as accurate as your Google one. Anaheim and Orange County businesses that do this reach iPhone users across Apple's apps.

faqs.a: Apple says Apple Business Connect is now Apple Business.
Capabilities from Apple Business Manager, Apple Business Essentials and Apple Business Connect.

faqs.q: Can I use my old Apple Business Connect login?
faqs.a: Yes. Apple says you can sign in with the same personal Apple Account.

faqs.q: Do I need a Managed Apple Account?
faqs.a: Only for the full feature set; a personal account still covers brand and location management.

faqs.q: Can I still advertise on Apple Maps?
faqs.a: Yes, in the U.S. and Canada, through Apple Business.

faqs.q: Does this change my Apple Maps listing?
faqs.a: Your listing tools remain; check verification and details after signing in.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses in Anaheim and Orange County?
